title: An ample invertible module over an affine base: a power is the pullback of O(1) along an immersion into projective space
statement: Let $A$ be a ring, let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] which is locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and let $\mathcal L$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module] which is ample on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. For $n\ge0$ let $P_n=\operatorname{Proj}(A[x_0,\dots,x_n])$ [def-pc-proj] ($\deg x_k=1$), with structure morphism $q_n:P_n\to\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ (on each standard open $D_+(x_k)=\operatorname{Spec}(A[x_0,\dots,x_n]_{(x_k)})$ it is induced by the ring map $A\to A[x_0,\dots,x_n]_{(x_k)}$), and let $\mathcal O_{P_n}(1)$ be the twisting module of [def-pc-projective-space-twist]. Then there exist integers $d\ge1$ and $n\ge0$, an immersion $i:X\to P_n$ [def-weil-closed-immersion] (a closed immersion into an open subscheme $U\subseteq P_n$ followed by the inclusion $U\to P_n$ [def-weil-open-immersion]) with $q_n\circ i=f$, and an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_X$-modules $\mathcal L^{\otimes d}\cong i^*\mathcal O_{P_n}(1)$, where $\mathcal L^{\otimes d}$ is the $d$-fold tensor power [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] and $i^*$ is the pullback of modules [def-pc-module-pullback].

proof.text: Obtain a finite affine section cover of L.tensorPow m with m>0 from the new common-power cover lemma. Ampleness also gives separatedness, and its quasi-compactness is hL.1.

Follow the proved source ProjectiveSpace.OfAmple argument: finite-type affine chart rings have finitely many generators, clear their denominators, and enlarge to one positive degree N. Form the cover sections and numerator sections of (L.tensorPow m).tensorPow N.

Use the proved native projective-space construction ProjectiveSpace.homOfIsFreeGenerator and twistRestrictHom. Retain the isomorphism witness omitted from the packaged source existence theorem. The preimages of the chosen standard charts equal the original affine section loci. On each chart the coordinate ratios contain the chosen ring generators, so isImmersion_homOfVector_divBasicOpen applies; target locality proves that the global morphism is an immersion.

The finite coordinate type is nonempty because it contains the nonempty cover index type. Reindex using the new finite-index scheme and twist isomorphism; compose the immersion with its hom. The structure-map equation follows by associativity.

The positiveTensorPower/tensorPow isomorphism is proved by two-step induction, the right unitor, tensor functoriality, and symmetry. Compose it with tensorPowMulIso, the retained twist isomorphism, the reindex twist isomorphism, and pullbackComp. Identify tensorPullback with the source pullback by uniqueness of left adjoints to the same pushforward. This supplies the degree m*N, its positivity, the base equation and the final module isomorphism.
